snippet.text: `noncomputable def nonbarPart (f : Source P) (z : Point P) : ℂ := f z - mean f z.1` with `Point P = P × Plane` (:20) for an arbitrary normed space P and `mean f p = coefficient f p 0` (:33), the unit-square (2-torus) average by `SmoothFourierData.coefficient_zero_eq_integral`; `nonbarPart_zeroMean` (:1007) gives `ZeroMean (nonbarPart f)` for smooth periodic f
